iso_boot: GRUB hybrid BIOS+UEFI (sovereign + rescue + ISO-file-scan entries), double QEMU-verified per build (classic AND Ventoy simulation)

core_stack.init: poler-init v0.4.0 (PID 1 sovereign boot supervisor: initramfs + system stages, engine supervision, poler.rescue=1 rescue mode, marker-file power control)
core_stack.shell: poler-engine v0.61.0 Terminal Gateway (PRIMARY console shell: double execution contour, pipes, redirects, native retrieval — official release binary from poler-engine-org/poler-engine, sha256-pinned)
core_stack.fallback_shell: poler-sh v0.2.0 (rescue/compat shell from Kotokvit/poler-sh; /etc/passwd root shell; forced via poler.rescue=1; ALSO shipped inside the initramfs as the interactive emergency console)
core_stack.power: poler-powerctl v0.4.0 (sovereign reboot/poweroff/halt: marker IPC to PID 1 — works from inside the engine gateway)
core_stack.archive: poler v0.1.0 (FastCDC + BLAKE3 streaming deduplication, from Kotokvit/poler)
core_stack.box: poler-box (kernel sandbox & seccomp isolation, from Kotokvit/poler)
core_stack.updater: poler-update v1.2.0 (native Rust: curl transport, sha256 verify, atomic install, sovereign engine channel --install engine)

engine_channel.engine: poler-engine v0.61.0 — installable on ANY system via: poler-update --install engine (official release binary, sha256-pinned)

real_hardware_boot.ventoy: ISO-file scan: the distro .iso as a FILE on vfat/exFAT/NTFS/ext4 — poler-init loop-mounts the ISO itself (GRUB entry 'ISO-file scan'; poler.findiso=1)
real_hardware_boot.direct: dd / Rufus-DD / optical: partition or whole disk carrying /poler/live.squashfs
real_hardware_boot.initramfs_modules: NVMe, xHCI/EHCI/UHCI/OHCI USB, UAS, usbhid keyboards, vfat/exFAT/NTFS3/ext4, SD/mmc, virtio, SATA/AHCI, squashfs+loop
real_hardware_boot.firmware: linux-firmware for real hardware (WiFi/BT/NIC/audio); GPU blobs purged — no graphics stack in the image, kernel text console needs none
real_hardware_boot.consoles: /dev/tty1 (physical monitor + keyboard, PRIMARY), /dev/console (serial), tty2/tty3 (Alt+F2/F3); emergency poler-sh console inside the initramfs ('exit 44' rescan)

rescue.grub_entry: POLER Sovereign Rescue (poler-sh console, engine bypassed)
rescue.purpose: guaranteed console access even if the engine gateway cannot start

legacy_purged: pacman (updates flow from GitHub via poler-update only)
